question:
Simplify the given expression.

(x²+3 x−10)/(x²−25) times (x²+3 x+2)/(x²−4) times (x(x+2))/((x+1)²+(x+1))
solution:
**Given:**

(x² + 3x - 10)/(x² - 25) × (x² + 3x + 2)/(x² - 4) × x(x + 2)/((x + 1)² + (x + 1))

**Formula used:**

Factoring quadratic expressions: ax² + bx + c = (a₁x + b₁)(a₂x + b₂)

Difference of squares: a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

**Calculation:**

(x² + 3x - 10)/(x² - 25) × (x² + 3x + 2)/(x² - 4) × x(x + 2)/((x + 1)² + (x + 1))

= ((x + 5)(x - 2))/((x + 5)(x - 5)) × ((x + 2)(x + 1))/((x + 2)(x - 2)) × x(x + 2)/((x + 1)(x + 1) + (x + 1))

= (x - 2)/(x - 5) × (x + 1)/(x - 2) × x(x + 2)/((x + 1)(x + 1 + 1))

= (x + 1)/(x - 5) × x(x + 2)/(x + 1)(x + 2)

= (x + 1)/(x - 5) × x/(x + 1)

⇒ (x)/(x−5)

Hence the correct answer is** Option 1.**
